title.en: Fluffy styling and detailed scissor work

text.en: Pet owners broadly commend Tail Spin Dog Spa for producing clean, sweet-smelling, and neatly styled coats. Reviewers highlight precise scissor trims, careful matting resolution, and cute aesthetic finishes. While two clients report issues with ear irritation and lingering shedding after deshedding treatments, most customers praise the salon's craftsmanship.

Clients frequently praise salon owner Dee and stylist Ariana for their warm customer service and professional expertise. Reviewers appreciate that the groomers take time to discuss coat condition, ear health, and dematting options before beginning. Aside from an isolated complaint about service satisfaction, pet parents describe the team as kind and trustworthy.

title.en: Patient care for sensitive canine guests

text.en: Dog owners emphasize that their pets feel comfortable, calm, and well cared for throughout grooming sessions. Reviewers note that nervous dogs and senior pets are handled with gentle patience during nail trimmings and baths. Many clients mention that their dogs eagerly pull toward the salon door, reflecting a reassuring and pet-friendly environment.

q.en: How long does a full dog grooming appointment take?

a.en: Reviewers report that standard full-grooming appointments are typically completed within approximately three hours.

q.en: Does Tail Spin Dog Spa handle dogs with matted fur?

a.en: Yes, stylists work carefully through coat matting, though additional detangling fees may apply for severe knots.

q.en: Can pets receive quick nail trimming walk-ins?

a.en: Clients note that quick nail clipping visits are handled efficiently and gently, minimizing stress for sensitive pets.

q.en: Where is Tail Spin Dog Spa situated in Toronto?

a.en: The spa is located on Dupont Street, serving pet owners across central Toronto neighborhoods.
